s1_c1_e1_line1: You want to race these streets? Fine. But Los Santos doesn't forgive amateurs.
s1_c1_e1_line2: One lap, one time. Beat the reference and prove you belong here.
s1_c1_e1_line3: Show me what you've got. The starting line is waiting.
s1_c1_e2_line1: Speed is good. Control is better. Show me you can tame that machine.
s1_c1_e2_line2: Chain the angles, hold the line. The score will speak for itself.
s1_c1_e3_line1: You passed the first test. Now we step it up.
s1_c1_e3_line2: Same circuit, but this time zero mistakes allowed. Every tenth counts.
s1_c1_e3_line3: Ready? Because I'm never short on expectations.
s1_c1_e4_line1: Some drivers see a ramp and brake. Others floor it.
s1_c1_e4_line2: Distance, height, style. Three factors, one goal. Do it right.
s1_c1_e5_line1: I've watched every run you've made. Not bad. But can you hold your own against someone pushing you for real?
s1_c1_e5_line2: One duel, face to face. No safety net, no excuses. Win or go home.
s1_c1_e5_line3: This is your last shot to impress me this chapter. Don't waste it.
s1_c2_e1_line1: Los Santos at night is a different world. Roads are clear, minds are free.
s1_c2_e1_line2: Beat the ghost of this night. It never slows down, never makes mistakes. You only get one shot.
s1_c2_e2_line1: The neons light up the asphalt. In these conditions, only the best stay in control.
s1_c2_e2_line2: Let your tires do the talking. Every degree of angle, every meter of slide counts.
s1_c2_e2_line3: Valdez is waiting for your score. Don't disappoint.
s1_c2_e3_line1: The ramp is right there, plain to see. What's less clear is where you'll land.
s1_c2_e3_line2: Commit fully and manage the impact. That's what stunt is about.
s1_c2_e4_line1: I set that time at 3am on an empty circuit. Nobody's matched it yet.
s1_c2_e4_line2: Think you can do better? I'm listening. But more importantly, I'm watching.
s1_c2_e4_line3: Prove it on the asphalt, not with words.
s1_c2_e5_line1: You've held your ground so far. Respect. But this duel is different.
s1_c2_e5_line2: I don't give breaks and I don't expect you to either. Go all in.
s1_c2_e5_line3: May the best driver win. This time, make sure that's you.
